en.title: Obsession Hits Peacock July 17 After Record-Breaking $400M Box Office Run
en.summary: The surprise romance horror hit **Obsession** is making its way to streaming after an unprecedented theatrical performance. Fans can mark their calendars for its arrival on Peacock next month.
en.body:
The cinematic landscape is still reeling from the improbable success of **Obsession**, a film that defied all expectations and has now officially set its sights on your living rooms. After an astonishing eight-week theatrical run that saw it shatter box office records, the romance horror darling will be available to stream on **Peacock** starting July 17, 2026.

Curry Barker's directorial debut, produced on a shoestring budget of just $750,000, has become a bona fide phenomenon. Globally, **Obsession** has amassed an staggering $403 million, with $245 million domestically and $157 million from international markets. This incredible haul makes it not only the highest-grossing film made for under $1 million but also the top-earning movie of Summer 2026, outperforming major studio tentpoles and even beating out a Star Wars and a Disney-Pixar joint in overall gross. The film's distributor, Focus Features, acquired it for $14 million at last year's Toronto Film Festival, a decision that has clearly paid off handsomely.

## From Theaters to Your Screen

The move to streaming comes after a theatrical window that, while longer than many 2026 releases, still represents a swift transition for such a massive hit. Focus Features typically operates on a 17-day window, and Universal's international extension was set at 45 days. **Obsession** will have enjoyed a 60-day theatrical run by the time it lands on Peacock. This strategic shift highlights the film's status as a 'money-printing machine' and the industry's ongoing adaptation to evolving viewing habits, even for films that prove incredibly resilient in cinemas. The question now is how this home viewing experience will compare to the communal thrill of its theatrical release.

## The Fan Frenzy Begins

Fans have been captivated by **Obsession**'s unique blend of romance and horror, fueling its word-of-mouth success. The debate around fair compensation for the crew, sparked by the art director as the film crossed the $300 million mark, also underscores the deep engagement audiences have with the film's production story. As it transitions to Peacock, the anticipation is palpable, with many eager to rewatch or experience the film for the first time without the constraints of a theatrical release. The success of **Obsession** has undoubtedly cemented its place in pop culture, and its streaming debut is poised to reach an even wider audience.

## What's Next

With its digital release date set for June 30th and the Peacock premiere on July 17th, fans have ample opportunity to dive into the twisted world of **Obsession**. Prepare for a new wave of discussions and analyses as the film becomes more accessible.

es.title: La obsesión llega a Peacock el 17 de julio después de una carrera en taquilla récord de $400M
es.summary: La sorprendente película de romance y terror **Obsession** llega a la plataforma de streaming después de una exitosa carrera en taquilla. Los fanáticos podrán disfrutarla en Peacock a partir del 17 de julio. La película ha recaudado más de $400 millones en todo el mundo, convirtiéndose en un fenómeno cinematográfico
es.body:
La película **Obsession**, dirigida por Curry Barker, ha sido un éxito sin precedentes en taquilla, recaudando más de $403 millones en todo el mundo con un presupuesto inicial de solo $750,000. Esta cifra la convierte en la película con mayor recaudación hecha con un presupuesto inferior a $1 millón, y también en la película más taquillera del verano de 2026, superando a grandes producciones de estudio y incluso a una película de Star Wars y una de Disney-Pixar.

## De los cines a tu pantalla

La transición a la plataforma de streaming se produce después de una ventana teatral de 60 días, más larga que la de muchas películas estrenadas en 2026. Focus Features, la distribuidora de la película, adquirió los derechos por $14 millones en el Festival de Cine de Toronto del año pasado, una decisión que ha resultado muy rentable. La pregunta ahora es cómo se comparará la experiencia de ver la película en casa con la emoción colectiva de su estreno en cines.

## La fiebre de los fanáticos

Los fanáticos han sido cautivados por la mezcla única de romance y terror de **Obsession**, lo que ha generado un éxito de boca a boca. El debate sobre la compensación justa para el equipo de la película, iniciado por el director de arte cuando la película superó los $300 millones, también subraya la profunda conexión que los espectadores tienen con la historia de producción de la película. A medida que la película se transfiere a Peacock, la anticipación es palpable, con muchos ansiosos por volver a verla o experimentarla por primera vez sin las limitaciones de un estreno en cines.

## Próximos pasos

Con su fecha de lanzamiento digital fijada para el 30 de junio y su estreno en Peacock el 17 de julio, los fanáticos tienen una gran oportunidad de sumergirse en el mundo retorcido de **Obsession**. Prepárense para una nueva ola de discusiones y análisis a medida que la película se vuelve más accesible.

content_raw: By pretty much any metric, Obsession is one of Hollywood’s biggest success stories. As we reported last night , Curry Barker’s directorial debut has become the highest-grossing film made for less than $1 million (unadjusted for inflation), and it did it in just eight weeks at the box office, thanks in large part to good, old-fashioned, strong word-of-mouth. It’s currently the seventh highest-grossing film of 2026 globally, beating out both a Star War and a Disney-Pixar joint. Though it fell from the top five at the box office last weekend , it’s still grossed more than $1 million at the box office every day since, besting Stephen Spielberg’s newer Disclosure Day . This is all to say, it’s a big, money-making hit, so, naturally, it’s about time to move it to streaming.  That’s right, Peacock announced this morning that Obsession will arrive on the streaming platform on July 17, just one week from today. Admittedly, two months is a longer theatrical window than most films in 2026 get. Focus Features, the distributor of Obsession , only operates on a 17-day theatrical window, per Deadline , and Universal, which distributed the movie internationally, is only extending its theatrical window to 45 days in 2027. By the time it hits streaming, Obsession will have gotten 60 days. Still, from where we’re sitting, Obsession appears to be a money-printing machine in cinemas—we’ll see how it fares against the multiple other screens of the home viewing experience.
